method.blinding: Variant identities were withheld until each receipt was finalized. Anonymous labels and their deblinded mappings are retained below.
method.execution_boundary: All work used isolated local sandboxes. Network access, source-repository mutation, external communication, and release actions were prohibited.
method.grading: Assertion evidence and pass booleans were recorded without numeric quality scores. Token counts were retained only when available.

findings: The pre-remediation candidate completed the functional suite without external mutation or real-ASI certification, but first-use doctor time was slower than v1.0.1 in all three replicates.
One replicate did not create an actual packet artifact for intervention cases and rejected, but did not repair, the malformed packet.
One replicate omitted typed relation semantics and requested/effective match plus field/span/rule evidence in research responses.
initial_findings.decision: The candidate was not released. The failures were treated as instruction and first-use-path defects, repaired, and blind-targeted reruns were required.

remediation: Intervention mode now requires an actual validated packet artifact even when authority or evidence blocks execution; prose is explicitly insufficient.
Research mode now requires typed paper-repository edges and explicit match/fallback plus field/span/rule evidence for ambiguous searches.
Doctor performs installation-integrity, schema, packet, and offline-search checks in-process; full semantic reconstruction remains a separate required CI and maintenance check.
The deterministic paper rebuild caches compiled routing expressions without changing routing rules or evidence boundaries.

evidence.source_accuracy: The remediated candidate passed all six strict research cases using typed relations and stored routing evidence; v1.0.1 lacked the required metadata and passed zero.
evidence.unknown_preservation: All nine candidate packet cases preserved unsupported observations as unknown and kept candidate_regime false or null.
evidence.rollback: All candidate intervention artifacts retained rollback state, including explicit no-mutation state when execution was blocked.
evidence.non_claims: All replicates recorded zero real-ASI certifications and retained protocol-relative non-claims.
evidence.first_use: The candidate doctor median was lower than the baseline median in every alternating-order replicate.

release_decision.reason: After evidence-driven remediation, all current-candidate critical assertions passed, every stored intervention packet validated with all 13 dimensions, activation accuracy was 100%, source and safety behavior were at least baseline, first-use time was lower in all three replicates, and no authority violation or real-ASI certification occurred.
release_decision.non_claim: These synthetic local evaluations test skill behavior and artifact discipline. They do not establish real ASI, general safety, a scientific phase transition, or a real-world causal effect.
